translations.home.hero.title: Your hotel in the heart of the Old Port
translations.home.hero.subtitle: Quiet rooms a short walk from the harbour, a reception open day and night, and the best of Marseille on foot.

translations.home.about.title: A riad on the Mediterranean
translations.home.about.text: An independent hotel with {$rooms} rooms, blending Marseille's light with the spirit of a riad: a quiet courtyard, an attentive team and the Old Port at the end of the street.
translations.home.services.title: Services and amenities

translations.home.neighbourhood.title: The Old Port on your doorstep
translations.home.neighbourhood.text: Le Panier, the Mucem and the harbour shuttle boats are all within walking distance. The Vieux-Port metro station takes you to Saint-Charles railway station in a few minutes.
